Modern VISUS datasets expose explicit dataset-level license fields, confirming that those license records can be resolved when present; their terms are not projected onto the 2014 benchmark.
Current public searches continue to recover the identifiers in the 2014 benchmark paper and later literature, but did not establish a current authoritative full-corpus distribution.

annotation_independence.published_process_summary: The first contributor performed the main annotation; the second added annotations and refined existing annotations.

claim_limits: This record is a dated authoritative-source recheck, not a source audit and not empirical validation.
Failure to recover a current authoritative full corpus is not evidence that no such copy exists.
The 2014 paper copyright notice is not treated as a license for the benchmark files.
Historical public availability does not establish current analysis-use or redistribution permission.
CC BY 4.0 licenses on modern VISUS DaRUS datasets are not transferred to the 2014 benchmark.
The reviewed public derivative material is partial and is not an authoritative replacement for the 25-participant by 11-stimulus benchmark.
Two contributors to one curation process do not establish two independent annotation streams.
No human-human agreement, model-human validation, Frozen Evidence eligibility, or raw-source redistribution is authorized by this record.
